title: [replay r3] Bug: main window disappears when it loses focus (macOS)
body:
> **Replay of [niway-dev/kaipu-record#255](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/255), run 3** for the code-review benchmark. Same base and head commits as the round-1 replay (a second branch name on the same commit, so the reviewer sees a fresh pull request). Never merged. Method: [wachiman/docs/benchmark](https://github.com/niway-dev/wachiman/tree/main/docs/benchmark).

---

Queue: niway-dev/agent-work-queue#9

## Summary
- Cause: applyDockPolicy() ran app.dock.show() on every call; on macOS that re-transforms the process and orders windows out and back in, which is the native blur → hide → show the diagnosis logged
- Fix: the activation-policy setters remember the last applied policy and return early when unchanged, so camera on no longer triggers a transition; real transitions still happen
- Added settings-store and recording-hub regression tests (fail on old code, pass now), moved the backlog page to ready-to-validate, bun run verify green, committed as 78e20a2; manual on-device check still pending

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] The hide-on-blur path is found and removed
- [x] A regression test covers camera on → main window stays visible

## Tests
Passed.
